title: review: skeptic result
description: One skeptic's verdict on a blocker/major cluster. Strict-mode compatible; the coordinator checks ranges itself.

cluster_id.description: Cluster id assigned in the prompt, e.g. C2.

severity.description: Severity after review. Equal to the original when confirmed; lower when downgraded; the original when refuted.

reasoning.description: Why the claim stands, is overstated, or is wrong.

evidence.description: file:line and quoted code (the guard, invariant, caller constraint or test), or a concrete reproduction.

unreadable.description: Every input you tried to open and could not. Empty when you read everything.

done.description: Exactly 'CHECKED <cluster_id>', set last and only after you checked the claim. Leave it empty if you could not read your inputs.
